parameters.subject: Offboarding Process - Important Information
parameters.message:
Dear {{ $('Store_Offboarding_ID').first().json.first_name }}

We acknowledge your departure from SN Connect. Your last working day is scheduled for {{ $('Store_Offboarding_ID').first().json.last_working_day }}.

Offboarding Checklist

Please ensure the following tasks are completed before your last day:

  • Return all company equipment (laptop, phone, access cards)
  • Complete knowledge transfer to your team
  • Attend exit interview
  • Update contact information for final payroll

HR will reach out to schedule your exit interview. If you have any questions, please contact hr@snconnect.local

Thank you for your service to SN Connect.

Human Resources Team
